sources.title: Mem0 raises $24M from YC, Peak XV and Basis Set to build the memory layer for AI apps
sources.summary: TechCrunch coverage of Mem0's $24M raise with founder backgrounds, the meditation-app origin story, traction metrics and the 'open, neutral memory' positioning against model vendors.
key_facts: Mem0 raised $24M total: $3.9M seed led by Kindred Ventures plus $20M Series A led by Basis Set Ventures (Oct 28, 2025)
Other investors: Y Combinator, Peak XV Partners, GitHub Fund; angels Dharmesh Shah, Scott Belsky, Olivier Pomel (Datadog), Thomas Dohmke (ex-GitHub)
Traction: 41,000 GitHub stars, 13M Python downloads, 80,000+ cloud signups; API calls 35M (Q1 2025) to 186M (Q3 2025), ~30% monthly growth
Mem0 is the exclusive memory provider for AWS's Agent SDK
Wedge: CEO Taranjeet Singh built Embedchain (8,000+ stars); users of a viral meditation app complained 'the app doesn't remember that'
CTO Deshraj Yadav led AI Platform at Tesla Autopilot; founders previously built EvalAI (1.6K stars)
Competitors named by TechCrunch: Supermemory, Letta, Memories.ai
Positioning: developers need 'an open, neutral solution' as model vendors make memory 'one of their key moats'
Business model: open-source API plus cloud service; model-agnostic (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source LLMs)

sources.title: AI Memory Problem 2026: How Mem0, Letta & Zep Give Agents Persistent Context
sources.venue_or_author: Trace Cohen, Six Point Ventures (Value Add VC)
sources.summary: A VC's July 2026 landscape note segmenting Mem0 (bolt-on), Zep (temporal facts) and Letta (OS-style runtime), with pricing and a context-drift failure statistic.
key_facts: Published July 22, 2026 by Trace Cohen, Co-Founder & GP at Six Point Ventures
Mem0: $24.5M total raised; 41,000-48,000 GitHub stars; 14M downloads; pricing free (first 10,000 memories) to $249/month
Zep: credit-based pricing starting $25/month; temporal knowledge graph powered by open-source Graphiti
Letta: $10M seed Sept 2024 led by Felicis; angels Jeff Dean and Clem Delangue; three-tier core/recall/archival memory
Claim: '65% of enterprise AI agent failures trace back to context drift'
Segmentation: Mem0 = bolt-on memory for existing stacks; Zep = facts that change over time; Letta = ground-up agent builds

sources.title: AI Memory Solutions Compared: Q3 2026
sources.summary: Q3 2026 side-by-side of the main open-source memory layers with star counts, pricing, licences, architecture and a warning that vendor benchmarks do not reproduce.
key_facts: GitHub stars on July 20, 2026: Mem0 61,323; Graphiti 28,981; Cognee 28,786; Supermemory 28,509; Letta 23,887
Mem0 vendor benchmarks 92.5% LoCoMo / 94.4% LongMemEval; Maximem reproduction (May 27, 2026) measured 73.8% LongMemEval
Letta pricing: free tier (3 agents), $20/month for 20 agents; ~74% LoCoMo vendor claim; Apache-2.0
Zep pricing: free tier; Flex plan $1,250/year for 50,000 monthly credits, +$25 per 10,000 extra; Neo4j or FalkorDB storage
Supermemory: MIT clients/MCP but closed engine; 81.6% LongMemEval vendor-reported; local single-machine binary shipped June 2026
Cognee: Extract-Cognify-Load pipeline with 14 retrieval modes; publishes no LoCoMo or LongMemEval score
LangMem (LangChain): pre-1.0 (PyPI 0.0.30, Oct 2025); p95 latency 59.82s 'impractical for interactive agents'
Cross-cutting finding: 'vendor-published benchmark numbers do not survive independent reproduction'
Mem0 gap: 'no native temporal model: it stores timestamps but cannot answer what a fact was on a past date'
Zep/Graphiti differentiator: bi-temporal graph with valid_at / invalid_at on every fact

sources.title: Honcho Review: Plastic Labs' Agent Memory Layer (2026)
sources.summary: Independent May 2026 review of Honcho's reasoning-first memory, with pricing, star count, benchmark comparison to Mem0/Letta/Zep/Hindsight and setup-cost trade-offs.
key_facts: Review dated May 26, 2026; Honcho at 4,301 GitHub stars (+644 that week); repo plastic-labs/honcho
Pricing: $100 free credits on api.honcho.dev; self-host free (Apache-2.0/AGPL-style); costs scale with LLM and embedding usage
Vendor claim: 90.4% on LongMem S using median 5% of context; review cites Mem0 ~65%, Letta 83.2%, Zep 63.8%
Hindsight reaches 91.4% on the same benchmark with single-binary simplicity; Mem0 wins on time-to-first-query
Setup ~30 minutes (PostgreSQL, Redis, LLM provider) versus Mem0's ~30 seconds
Architecture: reasoning-first 'peers' model (humans, agents, projects); background 'dreaming' deduction; MCP for Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf

sources.title: AI Agent Memory Architectures: From Context Windows to Persistent Knowledge
sources.summary: April 2026 research survey of memory architectures covering vendor claims, incumbent declarative-memory moves (Claude Code auto-memory, AutoDream), adversarial memory attacks, regulatory conflicts and open problems.
key_facts: Mem0 called 'most widely deployed semantic memory layer as of mid-2026' at ~48,000 stars
Mem0 claims vs OpenAI native memory: 26% higher accuracy, 91% lower p95 latency, 90% fewer tokens; Mem0g graph variant +2% accuracy
Zep/Graphiti: P95 retrieval 300ms with no LLM calls at retrieval; 94.8% vs MemGPT's 93.4% on Deep Memory Retrieval
Incumbent move: Claude Code auto-memory visible from ~v2.0.64 (late 2025); AutoDream background consolidation Feb 2026
Declarative memory files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules) now a cross-tool pattern
Security: MINJA attack (2025) >95% injection success, 70% attack success on naive memory stores; A-MemGuard misses 66% of poisoned entries
EU AI Act fully applicable Aug 2026; 10-year audit-trail duty conflicts with GDPR Article 17 erasure
Unsolved: scalability over years of history, GDPR fit, evals ignoring procedural memory, weak temporal reasoning
'95% of RAG systems as of 2025 relied exclusively on vector embeddings'; consensus shifting to hybrid vector+graph
Academic baselines on LoCoMo: MAGMA 0.7, Nemori 0.59, A-MEM 0.58, MemoryOS 0.553; MemoryOS (EMNLP 2025) +49.11% F1
